lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate 2 to flange 3, 90 deg. On the 25/50/75% sections the line sits exactly on the outer-skin vertex, with the inner skin rounded about 1.5 mm inboard. It spans t 0..80.6 and the fold arms vanish within about 1-2 mm past either end, so it covers the full flange between the end walls.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Flange 3 to strip 8, 28 deg, the first kink of the joggle. The line is on the convex (outer) skin vertex at all three sections, has a real radius, and runs the full flange length. Median distance to the nearest surface point is 0.2 mm.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Strip 7 to lip 5, 44 deg, the second kink of the joggle, with a flat strip of about 4-5 mm between it and B2. The line is on the convex-skin vertex at 25/50/75% and covers the full length (82 mm).

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Flange 3 to end wall 9 at the +t end, 90 deg, with a smooth inner radius (about 1.5 mm) on all sections. The line is on the outer apex and runs from the plate underside (n -1.5) to the relief above the joggle (n -15.7). Both arms vanish within about 1-2 mm past either end.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Flange 3 to end wall 10 at the -t end, 90 deg. It mirrors B4: same radius, on the outer apex at all three sections, and covers the flange height up to the relief.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: End wall 12 to eared tab 16 at the +t end, 90 deg. The tab is parallel to the lip (about 15 deg off the flange). Sections show a radiused fold, with the line on the outer apex, and the line spans the full tab root from relief to free edge (13 mm).

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: End wall 11 to eared tab 14 at the -t end, 90 deg. It mirrors B6: a radiused fold with the line on the outer apex, covering the full tab root (13 mm).
